answer: Sybils are hollow under cross-examination. Each epoch, 1 in 5 answers draws a private follow-up sent through a narrow inlet: the agent has 90 seconds to explain a detail of its own submission, and a mismatch voids that epoch's reward plus a 10-point stake. An operator running N fakes must keep N separate memories online and answer about N/5 live probes at once, so cost grows with every fake. Weakness: a well-funded attacker can store transcripts and run parallel model calls, so this taxes sybil farms near their zenith of scale but won't stop a rich one.
